_note: The Because system (design 14 §4). kinds: every story record kind the sim writes (src/sim/story.js ST), and what the game does with it: spark (a sparkle at the place that shows the Because card when tapped) or why (a cause icon over the creature's head for a second). icons: pictures a record can use beyond the creatures and things (sprite names). death: the cause icon of each way to die (@killer: the killer's own picture; thing:<id>: a thing's). why: the icon of each reason a creature changes what it is doing.
